title: OpenAI · 更新日志来源更新
summary: OpenAI 更新日志新增两条：API 密钥创建治理控制（组织/项目级）和 Usage Insights，表明平台在安全治理和用量可视化方面加强。

added_lines: Added API key creation governance controls at the organization and project levels. Administrators can allow only service-account keys, allow only user-owned project keys, or disable all new API key creation. Organization restrictions take precedence over project settings, and existing API keys are unaffected. See production best practices for details.
